plugins.name: fleet-orchestration
plugins.description: Run many Claude Code sessions on one codebase without them lying to each other — and faster. A zero-dependency CLI turns the protocol into eleven one-command rituals (validated heartbeats, census, the waiter's blocker check, typename-aware run-grouped PR checks, stale-verdict sweep, post-merge unblocks, jobs-not-runs CI load, digests), each with its evidence rule built in and each proved on a live run. Plus the session protocol, ten evidence rules each carrying its incident and its non-application case, a staleness monitor that reads a lane's artifact before calling it silent, and ten descending-model role definitions. Repo list, lane names and paths are configuration.
plugins.author: Markus Ahling
